subject: The secret workflow 99% of users never discover
preview_text: I analyzed our top users and found one setup they all share. It's not what you'd expect.
body_paragraphs: When I looked at the data, I noticed something strange. Our most successful users—the ones saving 10+ hours a week—aren't just using Smart Notes differently. They're using it wrong. At least, that's what I thought at first.

Turns out, every single one of them does this counterintuitive thing: they don't wait for the meeting to end. While everyone else hits record and forgets it, our top 1% are actively interrupting the AI during the meeting. They tap the screen when someone says something crucial, adding a quick voice note or keyword. It sounds like more work, but it trains the AI to prioritize what matters to YOU, not just what's being said.

This is why the 'Quick Tag' feature exists—that little microphone button next to the transcript. It's not for adding your own notes. It's for teaching the AI your personal priorities in real-time. One user told me it cut her review time by 80% because the summary already matched how her brain organizes information.

Try this in your next meeting: tap the mic icon just once when someone mentions a deadline or decision. Watch how the summary changes. You'll never go back to passive recording. P.S. The real secret? These users set up 'project tags' BEFORE the meeting. The AI connects everything automatically. Game changer.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes & Try Quick Tag
